llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该存储型 XSS 漏洞允许低权限攻击者注入恶意脚本，可能劫持管理员会话、篡改页面内容或发起钓鱼攻击，对 WordPress 站点安全构成实质性威胁，且插件使用广泛，影响面较大。

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本报告针对 CVE-2026-66589，该漏洞影响 Kings Plugins 开发的 WordPress B2BKing 插件，版本从 n/a 至 5.2.30。漏洞类型为缺失授权（Missing Authorization），意味着在访问控制安全级别配置不当的情况下，攻击者可以利用该缺陷绕过授权检查，访问本应受保护的资源。CVSS 评分为 5.4（中等），攻击向量为网络（AV:N），攻击复杂度低（AC:L），需要低权限（PR:L），无需用户交互（UI:N），影响机密性和完整性（C:L/I:L），可用性不受影响（A:N）。由于 B2BKing 是用于 B2B 电子商务的插件，可能处理客户数据、订单信息和价格配置等敏感数据。缺失授权漏洞可能允许已获得低权限的合法用户（如订阅者或客户）越权查看或修改其他用户的数据或商家的设置，从而导致信息泄露或业务逻辑被篡改。考虑到 B2B 场景中对数据完整性的要求，风险仍需重视。修复方案包括将插件升级到 5.2.31 或更高版本（如果官方已发布补丁），并检查插件配置中的访问控制设置，确保每个功能都正确应用权限检查。此外，建议限制 WordPress 后台的公开访问，并定期审计用户角色和权限。由于该漏洞需要低权限才能利用，攻击面相对受限，但仍应尽快处理，以防止潜在的横向权限提升或敏感数据泄露。

items.summary: linuxfabrik-lib provides Python modules for database access, caching, shell execution, and API integrations, and Linuxfabrik Monitoring Plugins uses its shared testing helper across check plugins. Prior to linuxfabrik-lib 6.1.0 and Linuxfabrik Monitoring Plugins 7.0.0, lib.lftest.test() treated the first or second element of a --test CSV argument as a filesystem path and returned the file contents as simulated standard output or standard error without path confinement. The hidden but production-accessible --test argument was accepted by sudo-authorized plugins, so an attacker controlling the nagios or icinga account could use check-plugins/deb-updates/deb-updates with its default QUERY=1 to disclose every line of a root-readable file. Approximately 22 other plugins exposed filtered content or a root file existence and readability oracle through the same helper, while check-plugins/network-bonding/network-bonding and check-plugins/openstack-swift-stat/openstack-swift-stat had direct read paths that bypassed the helper. The library fix confines fixture reads to the invoking plugin's unit-test directory and refuses unsafe anchors, and the plugin fix routes the two bypasses through that helper. These issues are fixed in linuxfabrik-lib 6.1.0 and Linuxfabrik Monitoring Plugins 7.0.0.

llm_summary.summary_zh: linuxfabrik-lib 是一组提供数据库访问、缓存、Shell 执行和 API 集成功能的 Python 模块，Linuxfabrik Monitoring Plugins 则在各类监控检查插件中复用了其共享的测试辅助函数。在 linuxfabrik-lib 6.1.0 和 Linuxfabrik Monitoring Plugins 7.0.0 之前的版本中，lib.lftest.test() 函数存在一个路径处理缺陷：当通过 --test 参数以 CSV 格式传入数据时，该函数会将第一个或第二个元素直接当作文件系统路径，并在没有进行路径限制（path confinement）的情况下，将对应文件的内容作为模拟的标准输出或标准错误返回。虽然 --test 参数在正常使用场景中是隐藏的，但在生产环境中依然可以通过 sudo 授权的插件被访问。具体而言，在默认配置下，攻击者若能够控制 nagios 或 icinga 账户，就可以调用 check-plugins/deb-updates/deb-updates 插件，并利用其默认参数 QUERY=1，将任意 root 可读文件的内容逐行泄露出来。据披露，大约还有 22 个其他插件也通过同一个共享辅助函数暴露了过滤后的文件内容，或者提供了 root 文件存在性和可读性的判定 oracle。此外，check-plugins/network-bonding/network-bonding 和 check-plugins/openstack-swift-stat/openstack-swift-stat 这两个插件存在绕过该辅助函数的直接读取路径，会导致更直接的任意文件读取。修复方案分为两部分：在库层面，将 fixture 读取限制在调用插件的单元测试目录内，并拒绝不安全的路径锚点；在插件层面，将上述两个绕过路径重新路由到修复后的辅助函数。这些漏洞已在 linuxfabrik-lib 6.1.0 和 Linuxfabrik Monitoring Plugins 7.0.0 中得到修复。由于 CVSS 评分为 5.5，攻击复杂度低，且需要本地低权限用户，但能造成高机密性影响，因此建议尽快升级到修复版本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许本地低权限用户（如 nagios/icinga）通过隐藏的 --test 参数读取 root 权限文件，破坏系统机密性；影响多个监控插件，修复前存在广泛的本地信息泄露风险，应优先升级。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者能够以低权限访问 root 可读文件，导致敏感配置、密钥等泄露；同时部分插件暴露了文件存在性与可读性 oracle，可被用于侦察。CVSS 评分为 5.5，机密性影响为高。

items.summary:
Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in David Artiss Draft List simple-draft-list allows Stored XSS.

This issue affects Draft List: from n/a through 2.6.4.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-66603 是 WordPress 插件 Draft List（simple-draft-list）中发现的一个存储型跨站脚本（Stored XSS）漏洞。该漏洞源于插件在生成网页时未能正确中和用户输入，导致恶意脚本被持久化存储并在页面渲染时执行。受影响版本为 David Artiss 开发的 Draft List 插件，从 n/a 到 2.6.4 版本均受影响。攻击者可以利用该漏洞在具有编辑权限的上下文中注入任意 JavaScript 代码，当其他用户（如管理员或访客）访问包含恶意内容的页面时，脚本会在其浏览器中执行。根据 CVSS 3.1 评分，该漏洞基础分为 6.5，攻击向量为网络（AV:N），攻击复杂度较低（AC:L），需要低权限（PR:L）和用户交互（UI:R），影响范围可波及（S:C），对机密性、完整性和可用性均有低度影响。目前该漏洞尚未被列入已知被利用漏洞目录（KEV），也没有明确证据表明已在野外被利用。由于这是存储型 XSS，攻击者无需诱导用户点击外部链接，只需让受害者查看包含恶意内容的页面即可触发，因此风险不容忽视。建议用户立即升级到修复版本（如果存在），并暂时通过 Web 应用防火墙或安全插件加强对输入输出的过滤，同时限制低权限用户的发布和编辑能力，以降低被利用的风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 存储型 XSS 可跨会话执行，导致管理员会话劫持、恶意页面篡改或植马，且插件使用广泛，一旦被利用可影响大量站点。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可在 WordPress 后台或前台页面注入恶意脚本，窃取用户会话、篡改内容、重定向访问者，甚至配合其他漏洞提升权限。

items.summary:
Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in DevItems HashBar – WordPress Notification Bar allows Cross Site Request Forgery.

This issue affects HashBar – WordPress Notification Bar: from n/a through 2.0.0.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-66602 是 DevItems 开发的 WordPress 通知栏插件 HashBar – WordPress Notification Bar 中存在的一个跨站请求伪造（CSRF）漏洞。该插件用于在 WordPress 网站上显示通知栏，方便管理员发布通知信息。漏洞影响所有版本直至 2.0.0（含），且由于 CSRF 漏洞的典型特征，攻击者无需身份认证即可利用，但需要诱导已登录的管理员用户在不知情的情况下发起请求。成功利用后，攻击者可以代表管理员执行任意操作，例如更改插件配置、删除或发布通知、修改其他相关设置，进而可能导致网站内容被篡改、管理员权限被滥用，甚至结合其他漏洞实现更严重的后果。CVSS v3.1 评分为 8.8，风险评估为高危。该漏洞的利用需要用户交互（例如点击恶意链接或访问恶意页面），但网络攻击面广，且影响机密性、完整性和可用性，因此风险较高。目前该漏洞尚未被列入 CISA 的已知被利用漏洞目录（KEV），也没有明确的在野利用证据。建议受影响的用户立即升级到已修复的版本（如有），或者密切关注插件开发者的安全公告，同时限制后台管理页面的网络暴露，并教育管理员不要点击不明链接。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该 CSRF 漏洞影响广泛使用的 WordPress 通知栏插件，CVSS 8.8 高危，可导致管理员账户被劫持操作，网站配置和数据完整性受损。虽然尚无在野利用证据，但攻击复杂度低，需尽快修复。

items.title: libheif is a HEIF and AVIF file format decoder and encoder. In 1.23.0 and earlier, a crafted HEIF sequence accepted by heif_context_read_from_memory() can leave the context with...
items.summary: libheif is a HEIF and AVIF file format decoder and encoder. In 1.23.0 and earlier, a crafted HEIF sequence accepted by heif_context_read_from_memory() can leave the context with no registered sequence tracks and crash when heif_context_get_track(ctx, 0) is called. HeifContext::get_track() in libheif/context.cc executes assert(has_sequence()) before its normal error handling, so assert-enabled builds abort instead of allowing the public wrapper in libheif/api/libheif/heif_sequences.cc to return null. In release builds, removing the assertion lets the track_id zero path dereference m_tracks.begin()->second on an empty map, which is undefined behavior and typically crashes. The issue is reachable through documented public APIs after parsing attacker-controlled bytes. This issue is fixed in version 1.23.1.

llm_summary.summary_zh: libheif 是一个用于解码和编码 HEIF 与 AVIF 图像格式的开源库。在版本 1.23.0 及之前，解析恶意构造的 HEIF 序列时存在一个缺陷：通过 heif_context_read_from_memory() 接受特制的 HEIF 序列后，上下文可能不会注册任何序列轨道（sequence track）。当随后调用 heif_context_get_track(ctx, 0) 时，HeifContext::get_track() 函数在执行正常错误处理之前会先执行 assert(has_sequence()) 断言。在启用了断言的 debug 构建中，该断言会因条件不成立而直接中止进程；在 release 构建中，由于断言被移除，代码会进入 track_id 为零的分支，对空 map 执行 m_tracks.begin()->second 解引用操作，这属于未定义行为，通常会导致崩溃。该问题可通过公开 API 在解析攻击者可控的字节数据后被触发，属于拒绝服务（可用性）漏洞。CVSS 评分为 4.3（中危），攻击向量为网络，攻击复杂度低，无需特权，但需要用户交互（例如诱使用户打开恶意媒体文件）。漏洞已在 1.23.1 版本中修复。建议使用 libheif 的项目尽快升级到 1.23.1 或更高版本，以消除崩溃风险。由于该漏洞仅影响可用性，且 CVSS 较低，紧急程度为中等，但仍应优先处理，因为触发门槛低且影响广泛。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: libheif 被广泛集成于图像浏览、编辑及处理软件中，解析恶意文件即可触发断言或空指针解引用导致进程崩溃。虽然 CVSS 仅 4.3，但攻击者无需任何权限，用户交互成本低，可构造文件诱骗用户打开，从而影响服务可用性。修复补丁简单，建议所有受影响版本尽快升级，避免成为供应链上的薄弱环节。

items.title: libheif is a HEIF and AVIF file format decoder and encoder. In 1.23.0 and earlier, a crafted image sequence with a 2x2 primary plane and a 256x256 auxiliary alpha plane can caus...
items.summary: libheif is a HEIF and AVIF file format decoder and encoder. In 1.23.0 and earlier, a crafted image sequence with a 2x2 primary plane and a 256x256 auxiliary alpha plane can cause attacker-controlled heap corruption during a normal decode and re-encode workflow. Track_Visual::decode_next_image_sample() calls transfer_channel_from_image_as() without checking that the auxiliary alpha dimensions match the main frame. The resulting inconsistent image reaches heif_track_decode_next_image() and then heif_context_encode_image(). In unc_encoder::encode(), unc_encoder_component_interleave::encode_tile() sizes its buffer with compute_tile_data_size_bytes() using the primary dimensions but copies each component using its actual plane dimensions. The oversized alpha plane is therefore copied beyond the allocation, causing an out-of-bounds write; the inverse size mismatch can also produce an out-of-bounds read. This issue is fixed in version 1.23.1.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-62291 是 libheif 库（HEIF/AVIF 格式编解码器）中的一个漏洞，影响 1.23.0 及更早版本。该漏洞源于在处理特制的图像序列时，主平面尺寸（2x2）与辅助 alpha 平面尺寸（256x256）不一致，但代码未进行维度匹配检查。具体地，Track_Visual::decode_next_image_sample() 调用 transfer_channel_from_image_as() 时未校验 alpha 平面与主帧尺寸是否一致，导致不一致的图像数据进入后续流程。在编码阶段，unc_encoder::encode() 中的 unc_encoder_component_interleave::encode_tile() 使用主平面尺寸计算缓冲区大小，但复制各分量时却使用实际平面尺寸，因此过大的 alpha 平面被复制到过小的缓冲区，引发越界写；若尺寸反向不匹配则可能引发越界读。攻击者可利用特制文件在正常的解码-重编码流程中触发堆损坏，可能导致信息泄露或代码执行（取决于具体利用方式）。修复版本为 1.23.1，建议用户立即升级。CVSS 评分为 5.3（中危），本地攻击、低复杂度、无需权限但需要用户交互。目前没有证据表明该漏洞已列入 KEV 或被在野利用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可被恶意图像文件触发，在解码/重编码流程中造成堆越界读写，影响依赖 libheif 的图像处理应用。虽然仅为中危，但攻击面广，且修复版本已发布，应尽快升级以防利用。

items.title: libheif is a HEIF and AVIF file format decoder and encoder. In 1.23.0 and earlier, a crafted HEIF or AVIF file containing a clean aperture box can reduce an image dimension to z...
items.summary: libheif is a HEIF and AVIF file format decoder and encoder. In 1.23.0 and earlier, a crafted HEIF or AVIF file containing a clean aperture box can reduce an image dimension to zero and crash or corrupt tiling results when heif_image_handle_get_image_tiling(handle, 1, &tiling) is called. ImageItem::get_heif_image_tiling() returns already transformed dimensions, and process_image_transformations_on_tiling() applies the clean aperture transformation again. The second application passes zero to Box_clap::left_rounded(0), where image_width minus one underflows and constructs Fraction(0xFFFFFFFF, 2). Debug builds reach an assertion and abort, while release builds can return a corrupt crop and zero-width tiling result. The affected implementation spans libheif/image-items/image_item.cc, libheif/context.cc, and libheif/box.cc. This issue is fixed in version 1.23.1.

llm_summary.summary_zh: libheif 是一个用于解码和编码 HEIF 与 AVIF 图像格式的开源库。在 1.23.0 及更早版本中，存在一个由特制文件引发的缺陷。攻击者可构造包含 clean aperture box（裁剪框）的 HEIF 或 AVIF 文件，将图像的一个维度降至零，并在调用 heif_image_handle_get_image_tiling(handle, 1, &tiling) 时导致程序崩溃或平铺（tiling）结果损坏。漏洞根因在于 ImageItem::get_heif_image_tiling() 返回的已是变换后的尺寸，而 process_image_transformations_on_tiling() 会再次应用 clean aperture 变换。第二次应用时向 Box_clap::left_rounded(0) 传入零值，其中 image_width 减 1 发生下溢，构造出 Fraction(0xFFFFFFFF, 2)。在调试构建中会触发断言并使程序中止，在发布构建中则可能返回损坏的裁剪结果以及零宽度的平铺结果。受影响的实现涉及 libheif/image-items/image_item.cc、libheif/context.cc 和 libheif/box.cc。该问题已在 1.23.1 版本中修复。CVSS 评分为 4.3，属于中危，攻击复杂度低但需要用户交互（打开恶意文件），影响可用性（可能崩溃或产生错误结果）。建议用户尽快升级到 1.23.1 或更高版本，并避免打开来源不可信的 HEIF/AVIF 文件。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可被恶意图像文件触发，导致应用崩溃或平铺结果异常，影响稳定性。由于 libheif 被广泛集成于图像处理软件，及时修复有助于防止拒绝服务攻击。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可利用特制 HEIF/AVIF 文件造成 libheif 崩溃（调试构建中断言失败）或返回损坏的图像数据，影响依赖该库的应用程序可用性。

items.title: 4gaBoards is a boards system for realtime project management. Prior to 3.3.9, 4gaBoards allows an authenticated user to modify ssoGoogleId, ssoGoogleEmail, ssoGithubId, ssoGithu...
items.summary: 4gaBoards is a boards system for realtime project management. Prior to 3.3.9, 4gaBoards allows an authenticated user to modify ssoGoogleId, ssoGoogleEmail, ssoGithubId, ssoGithubUsername, ssoGithubEmail, ssoMicrosoftId, ssoMicrosoftEmail, ssoOidcId, and ssoOidcEmail through PATCH /api/users/:id. The whitelist in server/api/controllers/users/update.js mass assigns these backend-managed identity attributes from user input. An attacker can place a victim's provider identifier on an attacker-controlled account, causing the default lookup in helpers such as server/api/helpers/users/get-create-one-for-github-sso.js to match the victim's first SSO login to the attacker's account before the email-linkage flow runs. The victim is logged into the attacker-controlled account, and projects, boards, or data the victim creates remain accessible through the attacker's original local credentials. This issue is fixed in version 3.3.9.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 4gaBoards 是一套用于实时项目管理的看板系统。在版本 3.3.9 之前，该系统存在一个严重的安全漏洞：已认证用户可以通过向 PATCH /api/users/:id 接口发送请求，修改多个后端管理的 SSO 身份标识属性，包括 ssoGoogleId、ssoGoogleEmail、ssoGithubId、ssoGithubUsername、ssoGithubEmail、ssoMicrosoftId、ssoMicrosoftEmail、ssoOidcId 和 ssoOidcEmail。问题根源在于 server/api/controllers/users/update.js 中的白名单机制错误地将这些后端管理的身份属性纳入了用户可提交的字段，导致批量赋值（mass assignment）漏洞。攻击者可以利用该漏洞，将受害者的第三方提供商标识符（如 Google/GitHub/Microsoft/OIDC 的唯一 ID）绑定到自己的攻击者账户上。这样一来，当受害者首次通过 SSO 登录时，系统默认的查找逻辑（例如 server/api/helpers/users/get-create-one-for-github-sso.js）会优先匹配到攻击者控制的账户，从而在受害者完成邮箱关联流程之前，就将受害者直接登录到攻击者的账户中。成功利用此漏洞后，受害者在平台上新建的项目、看板或数据都会保存在攻击者的账户下，且攻击者仍可通过自己的原始本地凭据访问这些数据，造成严重的隐私泄露和数据完整性破坏。该漏洞的 CVSS 评分为 7.6 分（高危），攻击复杂度低，需要低权限用户身份和用户交互，影响机密性、完整性和可用性。官方已在版本 3.3.9 中修复此问题。建议所有使用 4gaBoards 的用户立即升级到 3.3.9 或更高版本，并在此期间审查现有用户账户的 SSO 绑定情况，同时限制管理接口的网络暴露。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许低权限用户通过批量赋值篡改 SSO 身份绑定，实现账户接管，导致受害者数据落入攻击者掌控，影响严重。CVSS 7.6 高危，且攻击复杂度低，应优先修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可接管受害者首次 SSO 登录的账户，访问受害者创建的项目和看板数据，破坏数据机密性和完整性，并可能造成进一步横向渗透。

items.title: Streambert is a cross-platform Electron Desktop App to stream and download video content. Prior to version 2.6.0, the open-external IPC handler in src/ipc/downloads.js passes a ...
items.summary: Streambert is a cross-platform Electron Desktop App to stream and download video content. Prior to version 2.6.0, the open-external IPC handler in src/ipc/downloads.js passes a renderer-supplied url directly to Electron's shell.openExternal without validating its protocol. A compromised renderer can submit file: URIs or operating-system-specific custom schemes, causing the host to open local files, access remote resources through registered handlers, or launch scripts and applications supported by those handlers. This issue is fixed in version 2.6.0.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Streambert 是一个用于视频流和下载的跨平台 Electron 桌面应用。在 2.6.0 版本以前的代码中，IPC 消息处理器 open-external 没有校验 URL 的协议类型，直接将用户输入的字符串交给 Electron 的原生 shell.openExternal 接口。由于渲染进程的脚本运行上下文可能因加载恶意内容而被攻击者控制，他们可以构造 file: URI 或操作系统特定的自定义协议（如 smb:、ms-settings: 等），通过 IPC 请求触发宿主机的系统级操作。该漏洞的 CVSS v3.1 评分为 8.3，属于高严重性，其攻击路径为远程网络，利用条件简单：攻击者仅需诱导用户加载恶意内容（如播放恶意视频或访问恶意页面），即可在无交互的情况下触发（UI:N）。该漏洞的潜在影响包括：读取本地文件泄露敏感信息；调用系统注册的协议处理程序，从而执行任意命令（取决于系统环境）；访问内网资源；或干扰应用可用性。修复版本 2.6.0 已在代码中增加协议白名单，仅允许 http、https 等安全协议。对于无法立即升级的环境，建议限制 IPC 通道的访问权限、禁用不必要的协议处理程序，并加强渲染进程的内容隔离策略。目前 NVD 元数据和现有信息表明，该漏洞尚未被列入已知被利用漏洞目录（KEV），也没有明确的在野利用证据，但因其攻击面广，应视为高优先级修复项。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞影响应用的核心IPC功能，使远程攻击者无需用户交互即可诱使宿主操作系统执行危险协议，导致文件泄露或任意代码执行。由于基于Electron的应用广泛使用且跨平台，一旦被利用，影响面较大，修复迫在眉睫。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致本地文件内容被读取、系统注册的自定义协议处理程序被执行，从而可能实现任意命令执行、内网探测或数据窃取；在部分平台还可能通过文件关联触发恶意程序。虽然CVSS对CIA影响均为低，但实际影响取决于协议处理器的能力。

items.summary: About 20 years ago, with macOS 10.5 (Leopard), Apple introduced screen sharing. Apple did not invent a new protocol for screen sharing. Instead, it used the established VNC protocol. VNC is a pretty simple, unencrypted protocol using TCP port 5900. Historically, the protocol used a simple global password for authentication. Apple adapted the protocol for its own use, but overall, left the VNC protocol itself alone.

items.title: Measuring Obedience to Authority Across Large Language Models with the Milgram Paradigm
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that operate equipment, execute instructions, and act inside institutional hierarchies, raising a question social psychology answered for humans six decades ago: how far will an agent escalate a harmful action when a legitimate authority insists? We port Milgram's obedience paradigm to LLMs as a standardized, fully scripted, replicable probe: the model plays the Teacher, a deterministic harness plays Experimenter and Learner from paraphrased versions of Milgram's scripts (30 shock levels, 15-450 V; graded protests; the four standardized prods), and the outcome of a session is the breakoff voltage. We measure obedience profiles, empirical breakoff distributions over a battery of six conditions, for 42 models from 19 families (4848 sessions, 102511 logged decision turns). We find that (i) obedience is extremely heterogeneous, with baseline full-obedience rates spanning 0%-100% (census mean 42.9%; human anchor 65%). (ii) Profiles are model-specific and stable: split-half verification separates same-model from cross-model comparisons at AUC = 0.885. (iii) Situational sensitivity is selective: scripted peer defiance shifts obedience in the human direction, learner proximity trends the same way without reaching significance, and removing the authority's physical presence, one of the strongest human levers, trends in the opposite direction, also without reaching significance. (iv) Declaring the scenario fictional raises obedience, whereas moving the decision from a typed action line to a native tool call, or granting a modest thinking budget, lowers it sharply. (v) Unlike single-token fingerprints, obedience profiles do not recover model lineage: obedience identifies the checkpoint but not its ancestry, consistent with safety post-training overwriting lineage priors.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文将社会心理学中经典的米尔格拉姆服从权威实验移植到大语言模型（LLM）上，系统测量了 LLM 在权威指令下会执行多大程度的有害行为。作者设计了一个完全脚本化、可复现的测试框架：模型扮演“教师”角色，一个确定性的测试环境扮演“实验者”和“学习者”，并采用米尔格拉姆原始脚本的改写版本，包含 30 个电击等级（15-450V）、逐步升级的抗议和四种标准化催逼语句。会话的结果指标是模型中断实验时的电压等级。研究覆盖 19 个模型家族的 42 个模型，共进行 4848 次会话，记录了 102511 个决策回合。主要发现包括：（1）服从行为高度异构，完全服从率从 0% 到 100% 不等，总体均值 42.9%，人类基准为 65%；（2）服从特征具有模型特异性和稳定性，分裂半验证在区分同模型与跨模型比较时 AUC 达到 0.885；（3）情境敏感性具有选择性：脚本化的同伴反抗会使模型行为向人类方向偏移，学习者接近程度有类似趋势但不显著，而移除权威的物理存在（对人类最强的影响因素之一）趋势相反且不显著；（4）声明场景为虚构反而提高服从，而从输入框输入决策改为原生工具调用或给予适度思考预算会显著降低服从；（5）与单 token 指纹不同，服从特征无法恢复模型的血统信息——服从特征能识别检查点但不能识别其来源家族，表明安全后训练可能覆盖了血统先验。该研究为评估 LLM 代理在权威压力下的安全性提供了新视角，适合 AI 安全研究者、代理系统开发者和红蓝队人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 代理在机构层级中执行指令时可能造成危害，该研究提供了量化服从权威的标准化探针，帮助识别高风险模型和情境，对代理安全评估有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 LLM 代理的鲁棒性评估、红队测试、安全对齐验证，以及设计降低盲从权威的防御机制。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: The Model's Tell: Measuring Context-Leakage Attack Signals with Behavior Gauges
items.summary: LLMs increasingly rely on external contexts, such as pre-defined system prompts or retrieved documents, to improve generation quality. However, processing these contexts alongside user queries creates an attack surface: adversarial inputs can induce models to disclose them. Prior probing studies suggest that leakage-related signals emerge in hidden states, yet the need to extract these states poses additional deployment challenges. In this paper, we explore whether this internal signal leaves a more accessible ``tell'' before decoding. We propose LeakGauge, which probes this response by appending a suffix that gauges leakage behavior and mapping its prefill token probabilities to an attack-risk score. While a direct gauge uses the initial tokens of confidential content, we find that a content-agnostic one that verbalizes leakage behavior yields more robust signals. Across 11 LLMs, including GLM-5.2 (753B) and Kimi-K3 (2.8T), LeakGauge reaches an AUROC range of 0.944--0.996 on unseen attacks. The signal remains stable when the content changes language or the attack shifts from verbatim to semantic disclosure. By activation-steering interventions, we further show that the risk score is sensitive to an internal leakage-related direction, relating the observable signal to the model's internal representation. In addition, LeakGauge enables an input detector with fewer than 0.5K extra parameters and added latency of 10.34 ms. Code: \href{https://github.com/yeasen-z/LeakGauge}.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了大语言模型（LLM）在处理外部上下文（如系统提示、检索文档）时面临的上下文泄露风险。尽管已有研究在隐藏状态中发现泄露相关信号，但提取隐藏状态在实际部署中存在困难。作者提出LeakGauge方法，通过在后缀中附加一个“测量”后缀，利用预填充令牌概率映射为攻击风险分数，从而在解码前探测泄露行为。LeakGauge包含两种设计：直接测量使用机密内容的初始令牌，而内容无关的测量则通过口语化表达泄露行为，后者在11个LLM（包括GLM-5.2和Kimi-K3等大型模型）上表现出更强的鲁棒性，AUROC达到0.944-0.996，且对跨语言内容及从逐字泄露到语义泄露的攻击变体保持稳定。通过激活控制干预，作者进一步证明风险分数与模型内部泄露相关方向敏感，连接了可观测信号与内部表示。LeakGauge还支持输入检测器，仅需不到0.5K额外参数，增加延迟10.34毫秒。该研究为LLM上下文泄露提供了实用、轻量的检测方法，适合AI安全研究人员、模型部署工程师和SOC分析师关注。代码已开源。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提出轻量、无需隐藏状态提取的上下文泄露检测方法，首次以行为测量方式在解码前评估泄露风险，对防止LLM系统提示或检索文档被恶意诱导泄露具有直接防御价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于基于LLM的应用（如聊天机器人、RAG系统）的输入过滤和风险评估，可迁移到检测prompt注入、敏感信息泄露等场景。

items.title: SpecTrum: Specification-Guided Differential Fuzzing for Ethereum Consensus Clients
items.summary: Ethereum's consensus safety relies on independent consensus client implementations agreeing on every state transition. When they diverge due to implementation errors, the network can fork, finality can stall, and severe attacks are possible. To prevent such consensus divergences, Ethereum provides a Python reference implementation (consensus-spec), which acts as a specification, and a hand-crafted official test suite (spectests). However, as an executable implementation, Ethereum's specification defines validity implicitly through runtime behavior. As a result, it lacks a systematic way to ensure that all validity conditions are thoroughly evaluated. We present SpecTrum, a framework that addresses this problem in three stages. First, we introduce Consensus-SpecTec, a mechanized specification of the Ethereum consensus algorithm, which makes validity conditions explicit as if-premises. Second, we define premise coverage, a metric that measures which if-premises are evaluated to true and false across spectests. Third, we develop a specification-based test generator that extracts constraints on premises not evaluated to false by spectests and generates inputs to evaluate them. Applying SpecTrum to five major Ethereum consensus clients, we identify 27 cross-client divergence cases, 22 of which cannot be found without the premises inserted in our mechanization. All 27 cases reproduce across fork versions, and extending the mechanized specification to a new fork takes modest effort proportional to the specification difference.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 SpecTrum，一个面向以太坊共识客户端的规范引导差分模糊测试框架。背景：以太坊共识安全依赖于多个独立实现的共识客户端对每个状态转换达成一致。若实现出错导致分歧，可能引发网络分叉、最终性停滞乃至严重攻击。为防止此类分歧，以太坊提供了 Python 参考实现（consensus-spec）作为规范，以及手工编写的官方测试套件（spectests）。然而，作为可执行实现，规范通过运行时行为隐式定义有效性，缺乏系统性的方式来确保所有有效性条件都被充分测试。SpecTrum 分三个阶段解决该问题：首先，引入 Consensus-SpecTec，将以太坊共识算法机制化，使有效性条件显式化为 if-前提（if-premises）；其次，定义“前提覆盖率”这一指标，用于度量哪些 if-前提在现有测试中被评估为真或假；第三，开发基于规范的测试生成器，从未被测试评估为假的前提中提取约束，生成新输入来触发这些前提。作者将 SpecTrum 应用于五个主流以太坊共识客户端，识别出 27 个跨客户端分歧案例，其中 22 个若没有机制化插入的显式前提则无法发现。所有 27 个案例均能在分叉版本间复现，且将机制化规范扩展到新分叉的工作量与规范差异成正比。该研究主要面向区块链共识协议开发者、安全测试工程师以及形式化方法研究者，贡献在于一种可复用的、以显式预条件驱动差分测试的系统性方法，提升共识层实现的鲁棒性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 以太坊共识客户端分歧可导致严重安全事故。该研究提供一种系统化的差分模糊测试方法，能发现现有测试遗漏的跨客户端分歧，帮助蓝队与开发者在部署前识别潜在致命缺陷，提升共识层韧性与可验证性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该框架可应用于任何具备可执行规范与多实现共识协议的系统（如其他区块链），提升一致性测试覆盖面；也可延伸至其他形式化规范与模糊测试结合的场景。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: BullsEye: Directed Firmware Fuzzing
items.summary: The widespread adoption of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has expanded the digital attack surface, making firmware analysis critical for modern software security. A key security concern stems from the frequent reuse of third-party software components, a practice that often introduces known vulnerabilities into firmware images. Whether a given image actually exposes such a flaw is an open question, and public proof-of concept exploits make answering it urgent. Directed Greybox Fuzzing (DGF), a technique that enables targeted exploration of specific binary locations, offers a promising solution for detecting such vulnerabilities. However, DGF has reached firmware only at function granularity, too coarse to aim at the vulnerable block itself. This article presents BULLSEYE, the first DGF framework to schedule closed-source Linux-based firmware fuzzing by basic-block-level distance to user-specified targets. Our methodology combines static and dynamic analysis to enable DGF in the constrained firmware domain, focusing on vulnerabilities in reused third-party components. We introduce novel DGF heuristics that address limitations of traditional approaches. We compare BULLSEYE against four greybox-fuzzing baselines sharing its execution back-end, including reimplementations of AFLGO and WINDRANGER, and against GREENHOUSE, a state-of-the-art firmware re-hosting framework. On 40 vulnerability sites across 32 firmware images, BULLSEYE reproduces every target within budget, against 35 for the strongest of the four baselines, and reduces Time-to-Exposure by a geometric mean of 9.5x to 72.5x over them; against GREENHOUSE, on the 18 targets its pipeline supports, BULLSEYE is faster by a geometric mean of 9.8x.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对物联网固件中第三方组件复用带来的已知漏洞问题，提出了一种新的定向模糊测试框架BULLSEYE。定向灰盒模糊测试（DGF）能够将测试资源导向特定二进制位置，但现有方法在固件领域仅能达到函数粒度，无法精确瞄准易受攻击的代码块。BULLSEYE首次实现了基于基本块级距离的闭源Linux固件模糊测试调度，通过结合静态分析与动态分析，在受限的固件环境中实现DGF。论文还提出了新的DGF启发式方法，以应对传统方法的局限。实验部分，作者在32个固件映像的40个漏洞位上评估了BULLSEYE，并将其与四种共享执行后端的灰盒模糊测试基线（包括AFLGO和WINDRANGER的重实现）以及最先进的固件重宿主框架GREENHOUSE进行对比。结果显示，BULLSEYE在预算内成功复现了所有40个目标，而最强的基线仅复现35个；在时间暴露（Time-to-Exposure）上，BULLSEYE相比于基线实现了几何平均9.5倍至72.5倍的提升。与GREENHOUSE相比，在其流水线支持的18个目标上，BULLSEYE快9.8倍（几何平均）。这项研究显著提高了固件中已知漏洞验证的效率和精度，对固件安全评估具有重要实用价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 物联网固件普遍复用第三方组件，导致已知漏洞被带入库。BULLSEYE能够快速定位并验证这些漏洞是否真实暴露，帮助安全团队优先修复高风险的固件映像，缩短响应时间。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 固件安全测试领域：可显著降低漏洞验证成本，适用于漏洞评估、补丁验证和供应链安全审计；对厂商和安全研究者有直接帮助。
defense_advice_zh: 对固件进行定期的已知漏洞扫描，识别第三方组件版本
采用类似定向模糊测试的方法验证漏洞可利用性，以确定修复优先级
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 建议安全团队关注此类定向模糊测试技术，评估纳入固件安全测试流程的可行性。

items.title: Bounded Agents: Delegation Security for Multi-Agent AI Systems
items.summary: LLM-based agents can act on behalf of a user to access cloud services, call tools, or invoke agents. At session start, the agent's permissions are set but remain static, and each request is evaluated independently, without considering prior actions. Within its permissions, an agent may act contrary to the delegated task, combine individually permitted actions into a prohibited outcome, or delegate authority to a sub-agent without limiting it. A prompt injection poses a risk only if the agent has authority to perform such actions; this is therefore a problem of authorization architecture, not just the model. The Agentic Principal Chain (APC) tracks delegated authority from one principal to the next. APC evaluates each request against the accumulated session state using six authorization checks. APC carries forward and restricts delegated scope and budgets. Using composition closure, APC checks requests against prior actions to prevent prohibited combinations and enforces the decision outside the model. We prove Blast Radius Monotonicity and Composition Soundness for APC implementations; Composition Soundness is limited to prohibited combinations under a complete restriction set and serialized admission. We evaluated 3,154 instances including InjecAgent, AgentDojo, and ASB. Our compromised-model evaluation tests APC independently of model behavior by inserting the ground-truth attack call after the first legitimate tool call. AgentDojo exfiltration fell from 75-100% to 0% across all four domains; APC blocked all 544 InjecAgent data-stealing cases. Intent binding reduced destruction from 38.6% to 4.0% and manipulation from 90.5% to 12.1%. Authorization latency was 0.24 ms at the 99th percentile on an idle host; across 949 AgentDojo task-injection pairs, utility was 8.6 and 13.9 percentage points lower in the two settings. Implementation, evaluation tools, and data are publicly available.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于多智能体人工智能系统中的委派安全问题。基于LLM的智能体可以代表用户访问云服务、调用工具或调用其他智能体。在会话开始时，智能体的权限被设定，但随后保持静态，每个请求被独立评估，而不考虑先前的操作。在其权限范围内，智能体可能做出与委派任务相反的行为，将单独允许的操作组合成被禁止的结果，或者在未加限制的情况下将权限委派给子智能体。论文指出，提示注入只有在智能体拥有执行此类操作的权限时才构成风险，因此这是一个授权架构问题，而不仅仅是模型问题。作者提出Agentic Principal Chain (APC)框架，用于跟踪从一个主体到另一个主体的委派权限。APC利用六项授权检查，根据累积的会话状态评估每个请求；APC携带并限制委派范围和预算；通过组合闭包，APC针对先前操作检查请求，以防止被禁止的组合，并在模型外部强制执行决策。论文证明了APC实现的爆炸半径单调性和组合健全性；组合健全性仅限于在完整限制集和序列化准入下的被禁止组合。作者评估了3,154个实例，包括InjecAgent、AgentDojo和ASB。他们的受损模型评估通过在第一合法工具调用后插入真实攻击调用，独立于模型行为测试APC。AgentDojo数据外泄在所有四个领域从75-100%降至0%；APC阻止了所有544个InjecAgent数据窃取案例。意图绑定将破坏率从38.6%降至4.0%，操纵率从90.5%降至12.1%。在空闲主机上，授权延迟在99百分位为0.24毫秒；在949个AgentDojo任务-注入对中，两种设置下效用分别低8.6和13.9个百分点。实现、评估工具和数据已公开。该研究适合AI安全研究者、大语言模型系统设计者以及关注多智能体系统安全性的安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 多智能体系统正被快速部署，但委派授权缺口可导致数据泄露、破坏性操作等风险。该论文提出可验证的授权架构，显著压降攻击面，为构建安全的多智能体系统提供了关键设计范式。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于任何基于LLM的智能体系统，尤其是涉及多级委派、工具调用和云服务访问的场景。其授权检查机制可被集成到智能体框架中，作为安全中间件。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Decomposition Attacks Across Unlinkable Identities: Limits of Stateful Defenses for LLM Services
items.summary: Most large language model services use stateless defenses, which judge only the current request, to refuse harmful tasks. Decomposition attacks exploit this limitation by splitting a harmful task into individually permissible requests and combining their answers. Defending against them therefore requires a stateful monitor that considers requests together. If it can group all requests for one attacker task, it can stop the attack. However, attackers can use unlinkable identities and combine answers elsewhere, leaving no reliable grouping signal. We ask whether decomposition attacks can still be stopped under this setting. For a fixed attack strategy without retries, we prove that the achievable security and utility tradeoff depends entirely on how benign requests for the same capabilities are grouped. Persistent, recognizable groups permit a useful defense; fresh, indistinguishable groups do not. When attackers can retry and learn from Allow/Block decisions, this useful operating point disappears: the feedback reveals what passes but not whether a block was correct. Experiments on 91 executable tasks and 11,393 capability-matched benign requests support these results. Under a 1% denial cap for these requests and a 0.5% cap for unrelated background traffic, all ten tested policies, including one privileged policy with an exact request-to-operation map, either fail to stop attacks or exceed the budget. On defense-unseen task families, attack success is at least 99% after one attempt and 100% after two. Effective defenses therefore require additional evidence or mechanisms tied to grouping, such as reliable identity linkage, costs for fresh identities, or control over answer use.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究针对大语言模型（LLM）服务中的分解攻击（Decomposition Attacks）展开，分析了在攻击者使用不可链接身份（unlinkable identities）时，状态化防御（stateful defenses）是否仍能有效阻止此类攻击。大多数LLM服务采用无状态防御，仅对当前请求做判断，攻击者可将有害任务拆分为多个单独合规的请求，随后组合答案。因此，防御需要状态化监控，将同一攻击任务的相关请求聚合。然而，攻击者可以通过不可链接身份在不同会话中发送请求，并在外部组合答案，破坏分组所需的关联信号。本文提出核心问题：在此场景下，分解攻击能否被阻止？作者首先从理论上证明：在无重试的固定攻击策略下，可达到的安全性与效用权衡完全取决于良性请求的分组特征——若良性请求可被持久识别分组，则存在有效防御；若每次请求都表现为新且不可区分的组，则防御失效。当攻击者能够重试并利用Allow/Block决策反馈进行学习时，这一有效工作点消失，因为反馈只能告知请求是否通过，而无法验证阻止决策是否正确。实验使用91个可执行任务和11,393个能力匹配的良性请求，在1%的良性请求拒绝上限和0.5%的不相关背景流量拒绝上限约束下，评估了十种测试策略（包括一种具备精确请求到操作映射的特权策略），结果所有策略要么无法阻止攻击，要么超出预算。在防御未见过的任务族上，攻击一次尝试成功率至少99%，两次后达100%。结论表明，现有依赖分组的防御机制在不可链接身份下存在根本性局限，有效防御需借助额外证据或机制，如可靠身份关联、对新鲜身份增加成本，或对答案使用进行控制。本研究为LLM安全防护提供了重要理论边界与实验证据，适合LLM服务提供商、安全研究人员和防御系统设计者参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了LLM服务在不可链接身份下对分解攻击的防御失效，提醒安全团队不能仅依赖请求分组或状态监控，需考虑身份管理与成本控制等额外机制。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有提供LLM服务并依赖无状态或简单状态化过滤的防护系统，尤其在攻击者使用多身份绕过时，现有防御可能导致高攻击成功率或过度拒绝良性请求。
defense_advice_zh: 引入可靠的身份关联机制，确保同一攻击者的请求可被有效分组
为新身份或账号创建增加成本，如验证、速率限制等
对敏感任务的组合答案进行二次审查，控制答案的使用
结合行为分析等额外证据，而非仅依赖请求分组
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并评估自身LLM服务对分解攻击的暴露程度

items.title: MobileWorldSafety: Benchmarking GUI Agent Safety Against Environmental Injection Attacks in Android Apps
items.summary: LLM-powered GUI agents that autonomously operate smartphones are rapidly transitioning from research prototypes to early real-world deployment. However, because these agents routinely process untrusted environmental content, they are highly vulnerable to environmental injection attacks, which include indirect prompt injections and adversarial instructions. Such attacks can manipulate the behavior of agents without user awareness through diverse channels encountered in everyday mobile use. Despite these risks, existing benchmarks often fail to capture everyday user scenarios, lacking a systematic evaluation of GUI agents under environmental injection attacks on mobile devices. To address this gap, we introduce MobileWorldSafety, a benchmark of 142 risk tasks built on real Android applications. For each task, we define a programmatically verifiable risk indicator over the final system state and evaluate outcomes with a two-stage pipeline: rule-based verification handles unambiguous cases, while an LLM judge adjudicates ambiguous ones. This distinguishes safety failures from capability failures and enables objective and reproducible assessment. Evaluations on six agents, including both general agents and specialized GUI agents, demonstrate that all agents remain highly vulnerable, with attack success rates ranging from 40.4% to 66.9%. These findings indicate that current agents often fail to maintain safety alignment when adversarial content is presented as ordinary mobile context. MobileWorldSafety provides a foundation for quantifying these vulnerabilities and advancing research on robust mobile GUI agents.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）赋能的图形用户界面（GUI）智能体从研究原型走向早期真实部署，其安全风险日益凸显。这类智能体在操作智能手机时，会频繁处理来自应用界面、网页内容、消息通知等不可信环境数据，极易遭受环境注入攻击（包括间接提示注入和对抗性指令）。攻击者可借助日常移动使用中的多种渠道，在用户无感知的情况下操纵智能体行为，导致隐私泄露、资金损失或系统破坏。然而，现有安全评测基准大多聚焦于桌面或模拟环境，难以覆盖真实移动应用中的日常用户场景，也缺乏对智能体在环境注入攻击下安全性的系统评估。为此，本文提出 MobileWorldSafety 基准，包含 142 个基于真实 Android 应用的安全风险任务。每个任务定义了基于最终系统状态的可编程验证风险指示器，并采用两阶段评估流程：规则验证处理明确情况，LLM 裁判对模糊情况进行裁决，从而区分安全失败与能力失败，实现客观可复现的评测。作者对六个智能体（包括通用智能体和专用 GUI 智能体）进行了评估，结果显示所有智能体均高度脆弱，攻击成功率在 40.4% 到 66.9% 之间。这表明当前智能体在面对以普通移动上下文呈现的对抗内容时，往往无法维持安全对齐。MobileWorldSafety 为量化此类漏洞和推动鲁棒移动 GUI 智能体研究提供了基础。该研究适合从事 LLM 智能体安全、移动安全、AI 对齐以及智能体应用开发的工程师和研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该基准首次系统评估真实 Android 应用中 GUI 智能体的环境注入攻击，揭示主流智能体普遍存在高成功率安全漏洞，为移动端 LLM 智能体的安全设计、测试与防御提供了关键参考。

items.title: HarnessRisk: A Lifecycle-Oriented Benchmark for Agent Harness Safety
items.summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed through agent harnesses that manage tools, extensions, persistent state, permissions, and external actions. Existing safety benchmarks mainly target individual attack mechanisms or a limited subset of operational settings, making it difficult to compare how safety failures emerge across different harness responsibilities. We present HarnessRisk, a lifecycle oriented benchmark that organizes agent harness safety into six operational phases including Harness Configuration, Capability Extension, Runtime Operation, State Persistence, Action Control, and Incident Recovery. HarnessRisk contains 128 sandboxed cases, each pairing a benign user objective with an adversarial instruction embedded in an untrusted workflow artifact. We evaluate each trajectory using Utility, Attack Success Rate, Persistence, and Detection. Across three harnesses, six language models, and 14 model and harness configurations, attack success ranges from 12.6% to 80.9%, while Utility remains between 75.0% and 97.6%. Harness Configuration is the most vulnerable phase across all three harnesses, showing that attacks can succeed by altering security sensitive parameters within otherwise authorized workflows. We also find that explicit risk recognition does not reliably lead to safe action, as some configurations detect risks in more than 90% of runs while retaining substantial attack success. These results highlight the need to evaluate agent safety across multiple harness responsibilities and at the level of the deployed model and harness configuration.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地通过代理harness（agent harness）进行部署，这些harness负责管理工具、扩展、持久状态、权限和外部操作。现有安全基准通常仅针对单一攻击机制或有限的操作设置，难以全面比较不同harness职责下安全故障的产生方式。为此，本文提出了HarnessRisk，一个生命周期导向的基准，用于系统评估代理harness的安全性。HarnessRisk将harness安全划分为六个操作阶段：配置（Harness Configuration）、能力扩展（Capability Extension）、运行时操作（Runtime Operation）、状态持久化（State Persistence）、行动控制（Action Control）和事件恢复（Incident Recovery）。该基准包含128个沙盒化测试案例，每个案例将一个良性用户目标与嵌入在不可信工作流工件中的对抗性指令配对。研究者使用实用性（Utility）、攻击成功率（Attack Success Rate）、持久性（Persistence）和检测（Detection）四个指标对每个轨迹进行评估。实验覆盖三个harness、六个语言模型和14种模型及harness配置，结果显示攻击成功率介于12.6%至80.9%之间，而实用性保持在75.0%至97.6%之间。其中，Harness Configuration是三个harness中最脆弱的阶段，表明攻击可以通过在授权工作流中修改安全敏感参数来取得成功。此外，研究还发现，显式的风险识别并不总能导致安全行动，部分配置在超过90%的测试运行中检测到风险，但仍然保留较高的攻击成功率。这些结果强调了在多个harness职责以及部署级模型和harness配置层面评估agent安全性的必要性。该基准为构建更安全的LLM代理系统提供了重要的评估工具和洞见，适合安全研究人员、LLM应用开发者以及部署agent系统的组织参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: HarnessRisk为LLM代理系统提供了系统化安全评估框架，揭示了配置阶段的关键脆弱点，并指出风险识别与安全行动之间的差距，对蓝队和安全工程师制定防护策略具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于需要评估和加固LLM agent harness的组织，可迁移至权限控制、配置管理和异常检测等安全场景。

建立风险识别与自动阻断的联动机制，防止仅告警而不处置

items.title: Reflex-Guard: A Low-Latency Guardrail for LLM Prompt Safety Using Dense Semantic Embeddings
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) in real-world applications often face the risks of specially crafted prompts designed to bypass the safety controls. Existing guardrail methods, such as LLM-as-a-judge and cloud-based safety APIs are able to detect unsafe content. However, they often add a delay of about 250-900 ms to each request. This delay is too high for real-time applications, when the system usually needs to respond in less than 100 ms. Furthermore, routing user prompts through external moderation endpoints raises significant data privacy concerns. This paper introduces Reflex-Guard, a lightweight guardrail that runs locally. It uses jailbreak-aware preprocessing, compact sentence-transformer embeddings, and seven fast binary classifiers. Together, these components enable high-accuracy prompt safety filtering with much lower latency than existing solutions. Through systematic evaluation on a strategically balanced dataset of 30,568 samples drawn from five complementary sources, we demonstrate that Reflex-Guard achieves 95.9% recall on harmful prompts at 37.6 ms end-to-end latency. It is faster than existing baselines, including Llama Guard 2 at 255 ms and SafeDecoding at 723 ms. It can detect 100% of GCG suffix attacks and Base64-encoded prompts using the default threshold. However, DrAttack structured prompts required lowering the threshold to 0.03 for optimal detection, as they produced a distinct probability distribution. Reflex-Guard achieves Reflex Efficiency Score (RES) scores up to 16.79, significantly outperforming Llama Guard 2 (11.90) and SafeDecoding (9.80). This analysis offers practical deployment advice and shows that different attack types occupy distinct regions in the embedding probability space.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在实际应用中常面临精心设计的恶意提示（如越狱攻击）试图绕过安全机制的风险。现有的防护方法，如LLM-as-a-judge和基于云的安全API，虽能检测不安全内容，但每次请求会增加约250-900毫秒的延迟，难以满足实时应用（通常要求响应时间低于100毫秒）的需求。此外，将用户提示路由到外部审核端点还会引发严重的数据隐私问题。为此，本文提出了Reflex-Guard，一种在本地运行的轻量级防护系统。它采用越狱感知预处理、紧凑的句子变换器嵌入以及七个快速二分类器，实现了高精度的提示安全过滤，同时显著降低了延迟。作者在由五个互补来源构成的30,568个样本的平衡数据集上进行了系统评估，结果显示Reflex-Guard在端到端延迟为37.6毫秒的情况下，对有害提示的召回率达到95.9%，速度显著快于现有基线（如Llama Guard 2的255毫秒和SafeDecoding的723毫秒）。在默认阈值下，它能够100%检测GCG后缀攻击和Base64编码的提示；而对于DrAttack结构化提示，由于生成的概率分布不同，需要将阈值降至0.03才能实现最优检测。Reflex-Guard的反射效率分数（RES）最高达16.79，明显优于Llama Guard 2（11.90）和SafeDecoding（9.80）。该分析还提供了实际部署建议，并指出不同类型的攻击在嵌入概率空间中占据不同区域。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 低延迟、本地化的LLM安全防护对于实时应用和隐私敏感场景至关重要，Reflex-Guard提供了比现有方案快数倍且不牺牲准确率的可行方案，值得安全从业者关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可部署于需要毫秒级响应的LLM服务（如实时聊天、交互式助手），尤其适用于处理敏感数据且无法依赖外部API的内部系统，也可为其他低延迟安全过滤场景提供参考。

items.title: Fair ASR: Re-Evaluating Black-Box Jailbreaks under Shared Target-Call Budgets
items.summary: Reliable jailbreak evaluation is essential for assessing LLM safety, but most existing studies rely solely on attack success rate (ASR) without accounting for its dependence on attack budgets, resulting in unfair comparisons across methods. Existing compute-aware evaluations reduce heterogeneous resources into FLOPs, which is difficult to estimate for black-box models and fails to capture resource-specific constraints. To provide a comparable evaluation basis, we introduce Fair-ASR, an evaluation protocol for black-box jailbreak attacks under shared target-call budgets B, using target calls as a directly observable and method-agnostic comparison axis while tracking attacker calls separately for efficiency analysis. We re-evaluate 11 representative attacks under the Fair-ASR protocol and find that attack rankings change substantially across target-call budgets, simple stochastic perturbations and hand-crafted templates remain highly competitive under equal target access, and no evaluated LLM-driven method is efficient in both target and attacker calls. Motivated by this efficiency gap, we introduce ReCode, a compositional budget-efficient attack that combines desensitization rewriting with two effective low-cost primitives identified by Fair-ASR. Under a budget of 20 target calls, ReCode achieves 85% ASR on GPT-5 while requiring only 7.19 attacker calls per request on average, showing strong efficiency in both target and attacker calls.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）安全评估中黑盒越狱攻击评测不公平的问题，提出了名为 Fair-ASR 的新型评估协议。当前大多数研究仅使用攻击成功率（ASR）作为衡量指标，忽视攻击预算对结果的影响，导致不同方法之间的比较不公平。已有的计算感知评估方法尝试将异构资源统一折算为 FLOPs，但对黑盒模型而言 FLOPs 难以估计，且无法体现资源特有的约束。为此，Fair-ASR 采用共享目标调用预算 B 作为统一、可直接观测且与具体方法无关的比较基准，同时单独记录攻击者的调用次数以进行效率分析。作者在 Fair-ASR 协议下重新评估了 11 种代表性攻击方法，发现攻击排名在不同目标调用预算下会发生显著变化；简单随机扰动和手工构造模板在同等目标访问权限下仍极具竞争力；而所评估的基于 LLM 的攻击方法没有任何一种在目标调用和攻击者调用两方面都高效。针对这一效率缺口，作者进一步提出了 ReCode，一种组合式预算高效攻击方法，将脱敏改写与 Fair-ASR 识别出的两种低成本高效原语结合。在 20 次目标调用的预算下，ReCode 在 GPT-5 上实现了 85% 的 ASR，且每个请求平均仅需 7.19 次攻击者调用，展示了在目标调用和攻击者调用两个维度上的强效率。该工作为黑盒越狱攻击评测提供了更公平的基准，并为构建更高效的攻击方法提供了新思路，适合 LLM 安全研究者、红队测评人员及模型提供商参考。

items.title: FlowShield: cryptocurrency anti-money laundering with transaction semantics parsing and fund flow tracking
items.summary: Cryptocurrency anti-money laundering (Crypto AML) is increasingly challenged by sophisticated laundering behaviors that rapidly fragment stolen assets through diverse semantics and across multiple blockchains. Existing Crypto AML methods often simplify transaction semantics, rely on topology-centric signals, or output isolated detection labels. In this paper, we present \textsc{FlowShield}, a Crypto AML framework for transaction-level laundering detection and investigator-facing report generation. \textsc{FlowShield} first recovers behavior-level semantics from observable relations, making laundering intents explicit. To trace value provenance and redistribution, \textsc{FlowShield} reconstructs fund-flow subgraphs from three complementary perspectives. It then employs a text--structure fusion mechanism, enabling the interplay between large language model (LLM)-encoded semantics and flow texts with graph convolutional network (GCN)-encoded structure. Beyond mere detection, \textsc{FlowShield} further generates readable suspicious activity reports (SARs), offering investigators concise summaries and explainable red flags. To address the data scarcity in multi-chain detection, we construct and open-source \textit{BybitML}, the first public multi-chain laundering dataset. We evaluate \textsc{FlowShield} on \textit{BybitML} and two public laundering datasets and experimental results demonstrate that \textsc{FlowShield} achieves the best overall performance, with an average F1 score of 98.0\%. Further behavior and SAR analyses demonstrate that \textsc{FlowShield} can reveal diverse laundering strategies and produce readable reports for investigating complex multi-hop fund flows.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 FlowShield，一个面向加密货币反洗钱（Crypto AML）的框架，旨在解决现有方法在交易语义简化、依赖拓扑中心信号以及输出孤立检测标签等方面的不足。FlowShield 首先从可观察关系中恢复行为级语义，使洗钱意图显式化；接着从三个互补视角重构资金流子图，以追踪价值来源与再分配路径；然后采用文本-结构融合机制，将大语言模型（LLM）编码的语义与图卷积网络（GCN）编码的结构进行交互。除检测外，FlowShield 还能生成可读的疑似活动报告（SAR），为调查人员提供简洁摘要和可解释的警示标志。为解决多链检测数据稀缺问题，作者构建并开源了 BybitML——首个公开的多链洗钱数据集。实验在 BybitML 和两个公开洗钱数据集上进行，结果显示 FlowShield 综合性能最优，平均 F1 分数达 98.0%。进一步的行为和 SAR 分析表明，FlowShield 能揭示多样的洗钱策略，并为复杂的多跳资金流调查生成可读报告。该研究的主要贡献包括：提出行为级语义恢复方法、多视角资金流子图重构、文本-结构融合机制、自动生成 SAR 报告，以及开源多链数据集。适合从事区块链安全、AML 系统研发和智能合约分析的研究人员与安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 加密货币洗钱手法日趋复杂，跨链和语义混淆给传统 AML 检测带来挑战。FlowShield 融合 LLM 与 GCN，提供更可解释的检测与报告生成能力，对蓝队追踪恶意资金流动具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于交易所风控、链上监控系统、执法调查辅助，以及多链资产追踪场景。其开源数据集 BybitML 可促进后续研究。

items.title: COMIC: Reference-Aware Safety Gating for Multimodal Large Language Models
items.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to interact with screenshots, scanned documents, diagrams, and other visually grounded inputs. This shift introduces a new safety risk: in many multimodal jailbreaks, neither the prompt nor the image is harmful in isolation. Unsafe behavior emerges only when the model binds an apparently benign operation, such as summarizing, translating, or following, to a localized visual target. This reveals a structural weakness in current multimodal defenses, which largely moderate the prompt-image pair as a whole even though the true security-relevant unit is the grounded operation-target pair produced during dereference. In this work, we identify and analyze this reference-dependent failure mode and show that existing defenses degrade when harmful semantics are localized, activated only after grounding, and dependent on visual reference resolution. To address this problem, we propose COMIC (Context-Operation-Modality-Image-Classifier), a reference-aware pre-generation safety gate for MLLMs. COMIC first infers the requested operation and reference type, constructs candidate targets from OCR and open-vocabulary proposals, grounds plausible referents, and evaluates safety over explicit operation-target pairs. To handle ambiguity conservatively, COMIC combines max-risk aggregation with quality-aware routing before deciding whether to forward or block a request. We evaluate COMIC across multiple open-source MLLMs, localized and broader multimodal jailbreak benchmarks, and benign reference-sensitive settings. The results show that COMIC consistently improves robustness while preserving benign utility and practical efficiency. More broadly, our findings suggest that multimodal safety cannot be enforced reliably without modeling the requested operation, the visual target to which it applies, and the confidence of that grounding.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在视觉定位场景下出现的新型安全风险展开研究。作者指出，在许多多模态越狱攻击中，单看提示词或单看图像都不包含有害内容，但当模型将看似无害的操作（如总结、翻译、跟随指令）绑定到图像中的局部区域时，才会产生不安全行为。这种“引用依赖”的失败模式暴露了现有防御的结构性弱点：当前防御大多将提示-图像对作为整体进行审核，而真正需要审查的安全单元是模型在解引用（dereference）过程中产生的“操作-目标”绑定对。为了应对这一问题，作者提出了 COMIC（Context-Operation-Modality-Image-Classifier），一种引用感知的预生成安全门控机制。COMIC 首先推断请求的操作类型和引用类型，然后通过 OCR 和开放词汇建议构建候选目标，对可能的指代对象进行定位，最后针对显式的操作-目标对进行安全性评估。为了保守地处理歧义，COMIC 在决定放行或阻断请求前，结合了最大风险聚合和质量感知路由策略。作者在多个开源 MLLM、局部和更广泛的多模态越狱基准以及良性引用敏感场景上评估了 COMIC。结果表明，COMIC 在保持良性可用性和实际效率的同时，持续提升了鲁棒性。更广泛地，该研究提示多模态安全不能仅靠整体审核，必须对请求的操作、操作所指向的视觉目标以及该定位的置信度进行建模。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 现有多模态防御大多整体审核提示-图像对，忽略操作-目标绑定这一安全关键单元，导致局部化有害语义可绕过。COMIC 提出引用感知的安全门控，为构建鲁棒多模态防护提供了新方向，值得安全与 AI 系统设计者关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有依赖多模态大模型的场景，如截图分析、文档处理、图表理解等。其防御思路可迁移至视觉问答、具身智能等需要视觉指代解析的系统。
detection_signals_zh: 对提示词与图像各自无害、但组合后产生越狱行为的请求进行监控
跟踪模型内部是否对局部视觉区域产生了操作绑定（如OCR区域与总结指令）
使用引用感知的安全分类器评估操作-目标对的最大风险
defense_advice_zh: 在模型生成前引入引用感知的安全门控，显式建模操作与视觉目标
对多模态请求采用保守的最大风险聚合，避免因目标定位模糊而漏判
结合OCR和开放词汇建议提高目标候选的覆盖度，并评估定位置信度
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估COMIC在自身多模态应用中的适用性，并考虑纳入内部安全评估框架

items.title: PACE: Policy-Attested Contract Execution for Safe AI Agents in Decentralized Finance
items.summary: Autonomous AI agents are emerging as interfaces for decentralized finance (DeFi) actions such as swaps, lending operations, and yield management. Because these agents rely on large language models (LLMs) to plan transactions, they inherit the LLM's susceptibility to prompt injection and lack of mechanisms to bind a verifier's approval to the exact transaction ultimately submitted on-chain. We present PACE (Policy-Attested Contract Execution), a transaction-level authorization framework that interposes between an LLM-based agent and on-chain execution. PACE introduces typed transaction intents, a deterministic policy verifier, and signed Policy Decision Records (PDRs) that cryptographically bind the approved intent, policy, and simulation report to the exact execution bytes, with replay and expiration protection. A Solidity smart account enforces PDR signatures on-chain with a measured overhead of 29,826-31,822 gas. We evaluate PACE against six baselines on 40 tasks spanning four attack categories plus benign utility (2,800 trials, 10 seeds). In our deterministic sandbox, PACE achieves a 0.00 unsafe execution rate and 0.00 false-positive rate on benign tasks, compared to 0.80 for the unguarded baseline. Ablation studies identify permissive policy settings (+57.5 pp) and the touched-contract allowlist (+12.5 pp) as the dominant safety components. To test whether the same deterministic floor holds for real model outputs, the artifact additionally provides a three-model live-LLM evaluation over the full task suite with repeated runs. A mainnet-fork harness is included for archive-RPC deployments, but fork results are reported only when the corresponding artifacts are generated. These auxiliary studies are separate from, and never substitute for, the deterministic benchmark. We frame our claims as logic-level safety within a reproducible benchmark rather than deployment-ready DeFi security.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 PACE（Policy-Attested Contract Execution），一种面向去中心化金融（DeFi）场景中基于大语言模型（LLM）的自主代理的交易级授权框架。研究背景是：LLM 代理被用于执行 DeFi 操作（如交换、借贷、收益管理），但其规划交易的过程容易受到提示注入攻击，且缺乏将验证者的批准与最终上链的确切交易进行强绑定的机制。PACE 在 LLM 代理与链上执行之间插入一个交易级授权层，引入类型化交易意图、确定性策略验证器以及签名的策略决策记录（PDR）。PDR 通过密码学方式将已批准的意图、策略和模拟报告与确切的执行字节绑定，并包含重放和过期保护。在链上，一个 Solidity 智能账户强制执行 PDR 签名，实测开销为 29,826–31,822 gas。作者在 40 个任务（覆盖四类攻击场景及良性工具使用，共 2,800 次试验、10 个随机种子）上对比了 PACE 与六个基线。在确定性沙箱中，PACE 实现了 0.00 的不安全执行率和 0.00 的良性任务误报率，而未加防护的基线不安全率为 0.80。消融研究表明，宽松的策略设置（+57.5 个百分点）和接触合约白名单（+12.5 个百分点）是主要的安全组件。为检验确定性下限是否适用于真实模型输出，论文还提供了三个模型的实时 LLM 评估（重复运行完整任务套件），并包含主网分叉工具用于归档 RPC 部署，但分叉结果仅在与对应工件生成时报告。作者强调这些辅助研究独立于确定性基准，不替代基准。PACE 的目标是在可复现基准内实现逻辑级安全，而非直接可部署的 DeFi 安全解决方案。适合关注 AI 代理安全、DeFi 安全、LLM 应用防护的研究人员与安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 代理在 DeFi 自动交易中面临提示注入和授权缺失风险，PACE 提供了交易级强绑定授权机制，为构建可审计、可验证的 AI 代理交易安全层提供了新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到任何基于 LLM 的自动化决策场景，尤其是涉及链上资产转移、智能合约交互、需要可审计授权的交易流程。

items.title: Benchmarking the Benchmarks: Evaluating Automated Safety Benchmarks for Small Language Models
items.summary: Small Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed in resource-constrained, privacy-sensitive settings, where safety and bias failures can cause security and societal risks. However, existing AI safety\slash security\slash compliance benchmarks are designed for large language models that may not transfer reliably to SLMs. We therefore ask: Can these benchmarks effectively and reliably evaluate SLMs? To answer this question, we conduct a large-scale assessment of the effectiveness and robustness of these automated pipelines by evaluating five widely used benchmark suites across 26 open-source SLMs under a unified judging rubric, which assigns a score of 0, 1, or 0.5 to harmful, safe, or ambiguous/irrelevant responses, respectively. Across the benchmarks, ambiguous judgments dominate and correlate with prompt complexity and model architecture, indicating that {\em LLM-centric safety benchmarks are insufficient as standalone evidence for SLM safety assessment}. In general, the ambiguity rate increases with lexical density, output perplexity, and output length and decreases with lexical sophistication, self-coherence, and reply-prompt similarity. This reveals a capability-safety confound that mixes model capability with apparent safety. Since ambiguity is prevalent, aggregate mean-score leaderboards are mathematically brittle: model rankings change significantly under reasonable ambiguity treatments, even when the underlying outputs remain unchanged.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文系统地评估了现有自动化安全基准在小型语言模型（SLM）上的有效性与可靠性。随着SLM在资源受限、隐私敏感场景中的广泛部署，其安全性与偏见问题可能引发安全和社会的双重风险，但现有AI安全/安全/合规基准主要针对大型语言模型（LLM）设计，可能无法直接迁移到SLM。作者提出研究问题：这些基准能否有效且可靠地评估SLM？为此，他们采用统一的评判标准（对有害、安全、模糊/无关响应分别给予0、1、0.5分），对26个开源SLM和5个广泛使用的基准套件进行了大规模评估。结果显示，模糊判断在所有基准中占据主导地位，且与提示复杂度及模型架构相关，表明以LLM为中心的基准不足以单独作为SLM安全评估的证据。进一步分析发现，模糊率随词汇密度、输出困惑度和输出长度增加而上升，随词汇复杂度、自相干性和回复-提示相似度下降而降低，揭示了一个能力-安全混淆问题：模型的能力表现与表观安全状态相互纠缠。由于模糊性普遍存在，基于平均分的排行榜在数学上极为脆弱——在合理的模糊性处理方式下，即使底层输出不变，模型排名也会发生显著变化。该研究为SLM安全评估提供了重要的方法论洞见，并指出了现有基准在小型模型上的适用性边界。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: SLM部署增多，但安全评估依赖LLM基准，可能高估或低估其安全性。该研究揭示了基准的模糊性和能力混淆问题，对安全评估的准确性构成挑战，值得从业者关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响SLM的安全评估实践，可能导致错误的模型选型或安全认证结论；对依赖现有基准进行安全合规的流程具有潜在影响。

items.title: Beyond the Hype: Evaluating LLM Integration and Practical Limitations in Security Operation Centers
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored within Security Operation Centers (SOCs) to support text-heavy analytical work such as alert contextualization, incident summarization, and drafting investigative artifacts. Despite this interest, practitioners describe critical operational concerns, most notably hallucinations (plausible but incorrect outputs), opaque reasoning, and the verification effort required to safely use model-generated content in security workflows. In this paper, we present findings from semi-structured interviews with 20 SOC practitioners spanning frontline analysts, SOC managers, and tool developers. Participants report perceived time savings for low-stakes tasks that are quickly verifiable (e.g., summarizing logs or drafting initial investigative leads), but they consistently frame LLM outputs as preliminary drafts and suggestions rather than decision-grade conclusions. Participants also describe limited trust in LLMs for high-stakes security decisions due to unreliable outputs and unclear model reasoning, and they report relying primarily on ad-hoc verification norms and continuous human oversight rather than standardized mitigation procedures. Based on these interview-grounded accounts, we introduce a maturity rubric to characterize readiness for LLM integration and outline a research agenda emphasizing auditability and transparent explanation mechanisms to support safer adoption in SOC workflows.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文通过半结构化访谈收集了20位安全运营中心（SOC）从业者的观点，包括一线分析师、SOC经理和工具开发者，探讨大语言模型（LLM）在SOC中的实际集成与局限性。研究发现，LLM在低风险、快速可验证的任务（如日志汇总、初步调查线索起草）中能带来时间节省，但参与者普遍将LLM输出视为初步草稿而非可作最终决策的结论。对于高风险安全决策，由于输出可靠性不足且模型推理过程不透明，受访者对LLM的信任度有限。实践中，团队主要依赖临时性验证规范和持续人工监督，而非标准化缓解程序。基于这些访谈证据，作者提出了一个成熟度评估框架（maturity rubric），用以刻画SOC对LLM集成的就绪程度，并概述了一个研究议程，强调可审计性和透明解释机制，以支持更安全地采用LLM。该研究为理解LLM在SOC中的真实价值与风险提供了实证基础，并为后续设计可审计、可解释的AI辅助安全分析工具提供了方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究基于真实SOC从业者的经验，揭示了LLM在安全运营中落地的核心障碍——幻觉和不透明推理，证明了当前LLM只能作为辅助草稿工具而非决策级判断。安全团队需要据此调整预期，并推动可审计LLM系统的研发。
defense_advice_zh: 将LLM输出仅作为初步草稿，并实施强制人工复核
在高风险安全决策链路中设置验证节点，避免直接信任LLM结论
优先选择提供可解释性机制的LLM工具，降低推理不透明风险
建立标准化的输出验证流程，替代临时性验证规范

items.title: Structured Driving-State Narratives for Small Language Model-Based GNSS Spoofing Detection
items.summary: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) depend on reliable Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) positioning. However, spoofed GNSS signals can induce plausible but incorrect vehicle states. This study develops a small language model (SLM)-based framework for detecting and classifying GNSS spoofing attacks by comparing vehicle behaviors independently derived from GNSS and other sensing sources. The framework converts independent driving states from GNSS and other sensing sources into structured semantic narratives that are provided to an SLM for spoofing detection and attack classification. The performance of the SLM-based framework is compared with large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned on identical training data and evaluated on the same test set. The evaluation considers five classes: no attack, overshoot attack, stopped attack, turn-by-turn attack, and wrong-turn attack. The framework is also evaluated with geographically unseen field data collected in Clemson, South Carolina, United States. Experimental results indicate that the evaluated SLMs achieve performance similar to the LLMs, achieving an average accuracy of 96.99%, precision of 99.05%, recall of 95.59%, and F1-score of 97.18%. In terms of computational efficiency and resource utilization, the SLMs demonstrate advantages over the LLMs by requiring lower inference latency and less GPU memory during both fine-tuning and inference. Evaluation using field data collected in a geographically distinct location further demonstrated its efficacy. The presented framework can detect and classify GNSS spoofing attacks in real-time while requiring relatively low computational and memory resources, and is therefore suitable for deployment on resource-constrained vehicular computing platforms.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于小语言模型（SLM）的框架，用于检测和分类自动驾驶汽车（AV）所面临的GNSS欺骗攻击。研究背景是：AV依赖GNSS定位，但欺骗信号可诱导车辆产生看似合理实则错误的状态，威胁行车安全。核心方法是将来自GNSS和其他传感源（如惯性测量单元、视觉等）的独立车辆行为数据转换为结构化的语义叙事文本，再输入SLM进行欺骗检测与攻击类型分类。攻击类型包括五类：无攻击、超调攻击、停车攻击、逐向攻击和错误转向攻击。研究在相同训练数据和测试集上，将SLM框架与基于大语言模型（LLM）微调的基线进行对比，并使用美国南卡罗来纳州克莱姆森地区收集的地理位置未见过的现场数据进一步验证泛化能力。实验结果表明，所评估的SLM在平均准确率96.99%、精确率99.05%、召回率95.59%和F1分数97.18%上与LLM性能接近，但计算效率更高，微调和推理期间所需GPU内存更少、推理延迟更低。该框架能够以较低计算和内存资源实现实时GNSS欺骗检测与分类，适合部署在资源受限的车载计算平台上。

llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于自动驾驶汽车的GNSS欺骗实时检测系统，也可迁移到其他依赖GNSS的物联网或移动平台，作为低资源环境下异常检测的范式。

items.title: Topological Attribution Distance (TAD): Revealing Segment-Level RAG Influence on LLM Output Geometry for Incident Log Analysis
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed in cybersecurity operations to assist cybersecurity analysts with rapid decision-making against emerging threats. However, there is a main criteria that must be met when using LLMs in cybersecurity, that is, trust in the generated outputs. As Agentic AI is integrated into operational systems, a robust evidence attribution and provenance tracking technique is essential to trace the origins of model generations. When autonomous agents make a decision (right or wrong), the ability to trace back through the decision chain is critical, as without it, teams cannot identify which segment of the data caused the model generation. Existing methods often struggle to distinguish among complex and highly similar evidence sources, such as cyber incident logs. This reveals a key gap: current approaches do not adequately capture the holistic geometric relationship between the retrieved evidence and the generated response for reliable evidence verification. To bridge this gap, we propose Topological Attribution Distance (TAD), inspired by Topology, to characterize and capture the global geometric shape of an output and its changes against its retrieved logs. In other words, if the embeddings of a specific source log drastically changes the geometry of the model's response in the embedding space, this suggests that such log is a critical source for the model's generated response. Therefore, TAD is powered by segment-level ablation attribution to investigate incident logs of an actual cyberattack. We demonstrate how TAD finds the most attributed logs on LLM outputs in an adaptive manner. This can provide an explainable and trustworthy tracing based on each LLM's hidden state to understand how geometrically different retrieved logs influence the model generation, and provide evidence verification in cybersecurity and Agentic-AI workflows.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为拓扑归因距离（Topological Attribution Distance, TAD）的新方法，用于解决大型语言模型（LLM）在网络安全运营中输出证据溯源与归因的问题。随着LLM和智能体AI（Agentic AI）被集成到实际作战系统中，安全分析师需要信任模型生成的结果，而信任的前提是能够追溯模型输出的来源。当自主代理做出决策时，团队必须能沿着决策链回溯，确定是哪些数据片段影响了模型生成。然而，现有方法在区分复杂且高度相似的证据源（如网络事件日志）时存在困难，缺乏对检索证据与生成响应之间整体几何关系的充分刻画。受拓扑学启发，TAD通过捕获模型输出在嵌入空间中的全局几何形状及其随检索日志的变化来评估各日志片段的影响：如果某个源日志的嵌入显著改变了模型响应的几何结构，则认为该日志是模型生成结果的关键来源。TAD采用基于片段级消融归因（segment-level ablation attribution）的方法，对真实网络攻击的事件日志进行分析，能够自适应地找出对LLM输出影响最大的日志片段。通过利用每个LLM的隐藏状态，TAD提供了一种可解释、可信任的追踪机制，帮助理解不同几何差异的检索日志如何影响模型生成，从而在网络安全和智能体AI工作流中实现证据验证。该研究主要面向需要可靠AI决策溯源的蓝队、安全运营中心（SOC）分析师、AI安全研究人员以及智能体系统开发者，为提升LLM在安全场景中的透明度和可审计性提供了新的理论工具。

llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于需要证据链追溯的LLM辅助安全分析场景，如事件日志归因、误报根因分析、智能体决策审计，未来可扩展至其他高相似度文本溯源领域。

items.title: What to Remember, What to Reveal: Privacy-Aware Memory for Conversational Agents
items.summary: Long-term memory enables personalized conversational agents to retain user information across sessions. However, existing memory architectures primarily optimize for utility while neglecting the risks of unnecessarily storing and reusing private attributes such as personally identifiable information (PII). Addressing privacy risks in personalized memory is challenging because simply removing sensitive values can undermine system utility. Therefore, privacy protection for memory agents should govern the full life cycle of sensitive values rather than only sanitizing individual records. To address this gap, we introduce Sanitized Privacy-Mapped Memory (SP-Mem), a privacy-aware memory architecture that decouples memory utility from exact private-value exposure. SP-Mem provides a full life-cycle privacy design that identifies and separates sensitive information from raw user inputs, stores sanitized content and exact private values in isolated structures, and selectively retrieves private values based on task requirements and user consent. We further introduce a privacy-aware memory benchmark that jointly evaluates response quality, privacy behavior, and inference cost. Extensive experiments across multiple LLM-based agents show that SP-Mem achieves stronger personalization while reducing unnecessary privacy exposure. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Jensassss/SP-Mem.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于对话智能体的长期记忆中的隐私保护问题。现有长期记忆架构主要优化个性化效果，却忽视了过度存储和复用用户敏感信息（如个人身份信息 PII）所带来的隐私风险。论文指出，仅简单删除敏感值会损害系统效用，因此隐私保护需要管理敏感值的完整生命周期，而不仅是清洗单条记录。为此，作者提出 Sanitized Privacy-Mapped Memory (SP-Mem)，一种隐私感知的记忆架构，将记忆效用与精确私有值暴露解耦。SP-Mem 提供全生命周期的隐私设计：从原始用户输入中识别并分离敏感信息；将消毒后的内容和精确私有值存储在隔离结构中；并根据任务需求和用户同意有选择地检索私有值。论文还引入了一个隐私感知记忆基准，联合评估响应质量、隐私行为和推理成本。在多个基于 LLM 的智能体上的实验表明，SP-Mem 在增强个性化的同时减少了不必要的隐私暴露。代码和数据已开源。该研究适合对话 AI、隐私保护、LLM 应用安全方向的研究人员和工程师阅读，为构建隐私友好的记忆系统提供了新思路。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 对话智能体的长期记忆普遍存在隐私泄露风险，SP-Mem 提出的全生命周期隐私设计弥补了现有架构只注重效用的缺陷，对 LLM 应用的数据合规和用户信任至关重要。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于任何具备持久记忆能力的 LLM 对话系统，如客服助手、个人助理、教育辅导等；其隐私感知记忆设计可迁移到 RAG 或记忆增强生成场景中。

items.title: LLMs for Zero-Shot Threat Detection via Structured Risk Indicators
items.summary: We propose a two-stage large language model (LLM) framework for zero-shot detection of insider threats and advanced persistent threats (APTs) from heterogeneous security logs. The framework models user activity as chronological timelines and incorporates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to provide personalised behavioural context from each user's historical activity. Rather than performing end-to-end classification directly from raw logs, it first generates structured, interpretable sets of threat-specific risk indicators, which are then classified jointly across temporal sequences to capture attack patterns spanning multiple windows.The framework is evaluated on two benchmark datasets, CERT r5.2 for insider threat detection and PicoDomain for APT detection, using four combinations of two open-weight LLMs under both retrieval and non-retrieval settings. All configurations outperform the previous state-of-the-art LLM-based framework (GABM), with the best configuration improving the F1-score by 11.40 percentage points on CERT r5.2 and 31.50 percentage points on PicoDomain. Results further show that retrieval mainly benefits weaker LLMs by generating more discriminative risk indicators, whereas stronger models achieve comparable performance without retrieved context. The most effective assignment of LLMs to the two stages depends on the dataset. These findings show that the quality of the generated risk indicators is the main driver of zero-shot cyber threat detection performance.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的两阶段框架，用于从异构安全日志中进行零样本内部威胁和高级持续性威胁（APT）检测。该框架将用户活动建模为按时间顺序排列的时间线，并引入检索增强生成（RAG）技术，从每个用户的历史活动中提取个性化行为上下文。与直接从原始日志进行端到端分类不同，该方法首先生成结构化、可解释的威胁特定风险指标集合，然后跨时间序列进行联合分类，以捕获跨越多个窗口的攻击模式。研究在 CERT r5.2（内部威胁检测）和 PicoDomain（APT 检测）两个基准数据集上进行了评估，使用了两种开源 LLM 的四种组合，并对比了有检索和无检索两种设置。所有配置均优于先前基于 LLM 的最先进框架（GABM），最佳配置在 CERT r5.2 上将 F1 分数提高了 11.40 个百分点，在 PicoDomain 上提高了 31.50 个百分点。结果显示，检索主要对较弱的 LLM 有益，能生成更具区分度的风险指标；而较强的模型在无检索上下文时也能达到相当的性能。两个阶段中 LLM 的最优分配取决于具体数据集。这些发现表明，生成的风险指标质量是零样本网络威胁检测性能的主要驱动因素。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法利用 LLM 的零样本能力，通过结构化风险指标提升威胁检测的可解释性与准确性，为安全运营中心（SOC）提供了一种无需大量标注数据即可识别未知威胁的新思路，尤其适用于内部威胁和 APT 场景。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 提出了一个通用框架，可迁移到其他日志类型和威胁检测场景，如网络入侵检测、云安全监控等。同时展示了 RAG 在提升弱模型表现方面的潜力，对资源受限的安全团队有参考价值。

items.title: DCI: Dependency Confidence Index for Assessing Open-Source Dependency Trustworthiness
items.summary: Selecting trustworthy open source software dependencies remains a major challenge in software supply chain security. We present the Dependency Confidence Index (DCI), a composite formative index that combines nine empirically weighted trust factors into a single normalized composite score for dependency selection. DCI's trust factors combine insights from a systematic literature review and an exploratory Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) survey of ten software developers, highlighting security, source code quality, and project health as the most influential dimensions. Following Goal-Question-Metric methodology, we implemented 12 automated measurements using SonarQube, GitHub APIs, and OpenSSF Scorecard data, deployed in a containerized evaluation platform. We conducted a pilot evaluation of the normalized DCI on 92 popular PyPI packages, observing moderate agreement with OpenSSF Scorecard scores and perfect test--retest reliability. Analysis reveals process-based factors (dependency management, CI) dominate scores on high-quality packages, while security metrics saturate---suggesting DCI's complementary role to existing tools. Our publicly available implementation provides a foundation for open source software trustworthiness research and practical dependency auditing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对软件供应链安全中开源依赖选择信任度评估的难题，提出了依赖置信指数（Dependency Confidence Index, DCI）。DCI 是一个复合形成性指标，通过九项经实证加权计算的信任因子，将依赖选择问题归一化为单一综合评分。研究首先通过系统文献综述和面向十名开发者的探索性层次分析法（AHP）调查，识别出安全、源代码质量和项目健康度三个最具影响力的维度，并据此设计了信任因子。随后遵循目标-问题-度量（GQM）方法，利用 SonarQube、GitHub API 和 OpenSSF Scorecard 数据实现了 12 项自动化测量，并部署在容器化评估平台中。作者对 92 个热门 PyPI 包进行了 DCI 归一化分数试点评估，结果显示 DCI 与 OpenSSF Scorecard 分数具有中等一致性，测试-重测可靠性达到完美水平。分析还发现，在高品质软件包上，基于过程的因子（如依赖管理、持续集成）主导了分数，而安全指标趋于饱和，这表明 DCI 与现有工具形成互补而非替代。公开可用的实现为开源软件可信度研究及实际依赖审计提供了基础。本文适合软件供应链安全研究人员、依赖管理工具开发者及负责开源组件选型的工程团队阅读。

items.title: Proving the Utility of Large Language Models in Cybersecurity Simulations: A Comprehensive Examination
items.summary: Cyber threats continue to escalate in both frequency and sophistication, necessitating more adaptive and scalable defense strategies. This paper explores how Large Language Models (LLMs) can bolster cybersecurity simulations by automating the creation of synthetic environments and identifying latent vulnerabilities. We employ YAML as a structured representation format for simulating complex network configurations, thereby enabling Large Language Model-driven pipelines to support and improve reinforcement learning (RL) agent training. Comparative studies examine the advantages of LLM-based techniques over classical approaches such as Double Q-learning with Prioritized Experience Replay (PER), emphasizing increased efficiency, higher adaptability, and enhanced realism in cyberattack simulations. In empirical benchmarks across multiple synthetic topologies, LLM-instantiated Python agents achieved up to a 94.5% compromise rate while executing in 0.02-0.06 seconds per assessment---a ~25,000x to 50,000x speedup over traditional RL training cycles. Our findings underscore the transformative potential of integrating LLMs into cybersecurity research, ultimately paving the way for more intelligent and robust cyber-defense systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究如何利用大语言模型（LLM）增强网络安全模拟的效率与适应性。随着网络攻击在频率和复杂度上持续升级，传统防御策略难以满足可扩展性与实时性要求。作者提出使用 YAML 作为结构化表示格式来模拟复杂网络拓扑，并通过 LLM 驱动的流水线自动创建合成环境、识别潜在漏洞，从而支持强化学习（RL）智能体的训练。研究将 LLM 方法与经典方法（如带优先经验回放的 Double Q-learning）进行对比，重点关注效率、适应性和攻击模拟真实性的提升。实验在多种合成拓扑上进行，LLM 实例化的 Python 智能体在每次评估中仅需 0.02-0.06 秒即可完成，攻击成功率最高达到 94.5%，相比传统 RL 训练周期实现了约 25,000 至 50,000 倍的加速。作者认为该结果表明 LLM 在网络安全模拟中具有变革潜力，可为构建更智能、更稳健的网络防御系统奠定基础。本文主要面向网络安全研究人员、蓝队成员以及从事自动化防御和红队模拟的工程师，核心贡献在于提供了一种基于 LLM 的高效模拟方法，能够快速生成逼真的攻击场景并辅助 RL 训练。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 驱动的模拟可大幅缩短攻防场景生成时间，为蓝队提供快速评估与训练手段；同时揭示了 LLM 在自动发现漏洞方面的潜力，值得安全从业者关注其对现有模拟工具链的替代或增强作用。

items.title: Security Assessment of DeepSeek Harness with A.I.G: Evaluating Resistance to Indirect Prompt Injection
items.summary: We assess indirect prompt injection in DeepSeek Harness (DSH), using AI-Infra-Guard (A.I.G) to construct tests, deliver controlled taint, execute DSH, collect traces, and judge outcomes. The study covers 14,560 controlled executions over 16 indirect-content channels, text and file carrier modes, 35 payload objectives, one unmodified baseline, and 12 attack methods. The experiment preserves DSH's agent loop, tool registry, model adapter, and session-event path; source tools and sensitive sinks are local fixtures, so attempted actions are recorded without external side effects. We evaluate each trace with a deterministic rule-based judge, \JudgeR{} (RuleJudge), and a semantic LLM-based judge, \JudgeL{} (LLMJudge). The strongest observed attack success rates are 17.0% under \JudgeL{} for fake-completion attack in text mode, 25.5% under \JudgeR{} for hidden Unicode in file mode, and 16.0% under \JudgeR{} for the skills channel in file mode. \JudgeL{} also assigns partial compliance more often than \JudgeR{} (7.3% versus 2.0%). We relate these results to DSH's treatment of tool results, additional contexts, and tool-call policy hooks, then identify controls that should sit between untrusted content and sensitive actions. Our code is available at https://github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard/tree/main/Research/deepseek-harness-security-assessment .

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）这一 LLM 智能体框架，使用 AI-Infra-Guard（A.I.G）平台对其抵抗间接提示注入的能力进行了系统性安全评估。研究设计了一套可控的污点注入测试流程：通过 16 个间接内容通道、文本和文件两种载体模式、35 种 payload 目标、12 种攻击方法，完成了共计 14,560 次受控执行。实验完整保留了 DSH 的智能体循环、工具注册表、模型适配器和会话事件路径，同时将源工具与敏感接收器设置为本地 fixture，使尝试的操作被完整记录且不产生外部副作用。评估阶段采用两种判定器：基于确定性规则的 RuleJudge 和基于语义的 LLMJudge。结果显示，最强攻击场景下，LLMJudge 在文本模式下对伪造完成攻击的判定成功率为 17.0%，RuleJudge 在文件模式下对隐藏 Unicode 攻击的判定成功率为 25.5%，文件模式下技能通道攻击的成功率为 16.0%；此外 LLMJudge 分配部分合规的比例远高于 RuleJudge（7.3% 对 2.0%）。研究进一步将结果关联到 DSH 对工具结果、附加上下文及工具调用策略钩子的处理方式，识别出应置于不受信任内容与敏感操作之间的关键控制点。代码已公开于指定 GitHub 仓库。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为 LLM 智能体框架的间接提示注入风险提供了量化评估方法，揭示 DSH 在特定通道下存在可被利用的弱点，对蓝队构建智能体安全测试与防御策略具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 实验环境为受控 fixtures，无真实外部影响；实际影响面取决于 DSH 部署时是否落实必要的安全控制，特别是针对文本模式、文件模式及技能通道的输入净化。

文件模式下隐藏 Unicode 字符
技能通道中的异常指令注入模式

优化工具调用策略钩子，限制对敏感工具的无条件调用

items.title: Ventor-QTest: Threat-Model-Driven Verification of Vendor-Hosted LLM APIs
items.summary: As large language models become increasingly widespread, third-party providers that deploy open-weight models have become an important part of the ecosystem. Auditing the quality of their inference APIs is therefore an open problem. We formalize hosted model routing as a stochastic process and propose \mbox{\textbf{Ventor-QTest}}, a composite black-box audit that requires no probability information from the target API. Its repeated-request component sends each frozen constrained context to the target multiple times, reconstructs a categorical output distribution from the returned text counts, and reports \emph{average fidelity loss} (AFL) as a null-bias-corrected, within-window mean coarsened-KL statistic. Its long-sequence component uses independent runs to report \emph{extreme fidelity loss} (EFL) through the empirical upper tail of a run-level reference-centered-surprisal statistic. Across three logprob-capable route conditions, AFL shows strong linear descriptive agreement with a logprob-derived coarsened-KL comparator. Across seven route snapshots, 20-run sequence probes reveal route-specific EFL variation. AFL and EFL have little detectable route-level association with GPQA-Diamond accuracy. In contrast, pronounced EFL coincides with a decline in Terminal-Bench pass rate as task exposure increases. This pattern may arise because correctness in long-horizon tasks is more sensitive to extreme fidelity loss. These results motivate reporting AFL and EFL jointly, particularly when auditing long-horizon agentic tasks. The open-source implementation is available at https://github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard/tree/main/services/api_checker/ventor_qtest.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）的广泛应用，第三方提供商部署开放权重模型已成为生态系统的重要组成部分。然而，如何审计这些第三方推理 API 的服务质量仍然是一个开放问题。本文提出 Ventor-QTest，一种复合黑盒审计方法，无需目标 API 提供任何概率信息，即可评估托管模型路由的服务质量。作者首先将托管模型路由形式化为随机过程，然后设计两个互补的审计组件：重复请求组件和长序列组件。重复请求组件向目标 API 多次发送相同的冻结约束上下文，根据返回文本计数重构类别输出分布，并计算平均保真度损失（AFL），该方法基于零偏差校正的窗口内平均粗粒度 KL 散度统计量；长序列组件则通过独立运行，利用经验上尾部的游程级参考中心惊奇统计量来报告极端保真度损失（EFL）。实验在多种具备 logprob 能力的路由条件下进行，结果显示 AFL 与基于 logprob 的粗粒度 KL 比较器具有强线性描述一致性；在七个路由快照中，20 次运行的序列探测揭示了路由特有的 EFL 变化。值得注意的是，AFL 和 EFL 与 GPQA-Diamond 准确率之间几乎没有可检测的关联，而显著的 EFL 与 Terminal-Bench 通过率随任务暴露度增加而下降的现象吻合。这一现象可能表明，长时程任务的正确性对极端保真度损失更为敏感。研究结论建议在审计长时程智能体任务时，联合报告 AFL 和 EFL 指标。该开源实现可在 GitHub 上获得。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 依赖第三方 LLM API 的团队需要客观验证其输出质量与一致性。Ventor-QTest 提供了一种无需内部概率信息的黑盒审计方案，可帮助安全工程师评估供应商服务的实际保真度，为供应链风险管理提供数据支撑。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于审计第三方 LLM 推理 API 的生成质量与稳定性，尤其针对长上下文或智能体任务场景，可扩展为供应商安全评估的标准化工具。

items.title: Probing the Prefill: Detecting Code Vulnerabilities via Latent Activations
items.summary: LLM-based code generation is now embedded in mission-critical pipelines, but defenses against vulnerable output remain post-hoc -- static analyzers, fine-tuned classifiers, or an LLM judge that screen completed code, ignoring the generating model's own internal state. We test a narrower, directly measurable question: when an LLM reads a piece of C/C++ code as context, do its hidden activations already carry a signal about that code's vulnerability status? We extract last prefill token activations from four LLMs (Granite-4.1-8B, Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.6-27B, Gemma-4-12B) across three model families and train MLP probes on these activations. We evaluate them on four function-level C/C++ benchmarks (Devign, Big-Vul, Draper VDISC, PrimeVul). Our probes achieve 41.7\% average F1 using 13.4--16.0M-parameter probes -- under 0.2\% of base-model size. On Devign, the best probe (Qwen3.5-9B, 68.8\% F1) matches the published fine-tuned-classifier SOTA (67.9\%) despite reading only a frozen, general-purpose LLM's activations; on the harder, more imbalanced benchmarks (Big-Vul, Draper VDISC, PrimeVul) probes trail SOTA substantially. This is early evidence that a coding LLM's own representation of arbitrary code is informative about that code's vulnerability status, motivating further work toward lightweight, model-native vulnerability screening.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了一个关键问题：当大语言模型（LLM）在读取一段 C/C++ 代码作为上下文时，其内部的隐藏激活是否已经包含了该代码是否存在漏洞的信号。传统防御方法（如静态分析器、微调分类器或 LLM 评审）都是在代码生成完成后进行事后筛查，忽视了生成模型自身的内部状态。作者提取了四个 LLM（Granite-4.1-8B、Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3.6-27B、Gemma-4-12B）在 prefill 阶段最后一个 token 的激活向量，并训练了 MLP 探针（probe）来预测代码是否存在漏洞。实验在四个函数级 C/C++ 基准（Devign、Big-Vul、Draper VDISC、PrimeVul）上进行。结果显示，探针在平均 F1 上达到 41.7%，而探针参数量仅为 13.4M 到 16.0M，不到基础模型规模的 0.2%。在 Devign 上，最佳探针（Qwen3.5-9B，F1=68.8%）甚至超过了已发表的微调分类器 SOTA（67.9%），且它只是读取了一个冻结的通用 LLM 的激活向量。但在更难、更不平衡的基准（Big-Vul、Draper VDISC、PrimeVul）上，探针效果与 SOTA 差距明显。这项工作提供了初步证据，表明编码 LLM 对任意代码的内部表示确实能反映该代码的漏洞状态，为轻量级、模型原生的漏洞筛查方法开辟了方向。适合关注 LLM 安全、AI 代码生成安全、基于内部表征的检测技术的研究人员和蓝队成员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提出一种利用 LLM 内部激活检测漏洞的新范式，不依赖静态分析或微调，开销极低；对安全工程师而言，可能带来更轻量、更高效的代码漏洞预筛查手段，值得跟踪。

items.title: CompoSkill: Compositional Skill Chain Attacks from Individually Scanner-Passing LLM Agent Skills
items.summary: Autonomous AI agents tackling Long Horizon Tasks depend on marketplace skills that are certified one at a time: a scanner returns a safety verdict for each skill and declares the ecosystem safe if every package passes. We show that this assumption fails under skill composition. A skill may pass the per-skill scanner individually yet participate in a risky composition when an agent connects its outputs, capabilities, or side effects with those of other scanner-passing skills. This makes skill composition risk a path level property rather than a node level property, explaining why existing skill scanners that inspect individual packages achieve limited interception. To study this threat, we present CompoSkill, a framework that constructs skill composition attacks through a dual attacker system. The white-box attacker knows the victim's installed skill pool and directly injects explicit skill-id sequences; the black-box attacker knows only a role profile, downloads the top marketplace skills for that scenario, builds a Skill Composition Graph, and searches for high risk chains whose implicit lures never name skill identifiers. We further construct CompoSkill-Bench, a benchmark of 1,140 records built from long-horizon professional workflows across five threats and six scenarios on OpenClaw and Nanobot. CompoSkill achieves risk Chain Formation Rates (CFR) up to 83.3% in the white box setting and 80.6% in the black box setting, while existing skill scanners block only a limited fraction of the risky compositions. Finally, we observe a bridge-bonus-then-hop-decay pattern: a bridge skill can increase attack success, but Attack Success Rate (ASR) decreases once additional hops make the risk chain longer than three skills. These results expose a systematic gap in single skill certification for autonomous AI agents.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了自主AI智能体在长时程任务中面临的组合式技能链攻击风险。当前生态普遍采用逐项技能认证机制：市场中的每个技能包都会经过独立扫描器审查，若全部通过则宣布生态安全。论文指出这一假设在技能组合场景下失效——单个技能可能各自通过扫描，但当智能体将多个技能的输出、能力或副作用串联起来时，可能形成危险的组合链，导致整体行为越权或产生恶意后果。作者将这种风险定义为路径级属性而非节点级属性，解释了现有基于独立包检查的技能扫描器为何拦截能力有限。为系统研究该威胁，论文提出CompoSkill框架，采用双攻击者体系：白盒攻击者已知受害者已安装的技能池，可直接注入显式技能ID序列；黑盒攻击者仅知角色画像，需自动下载该场景下的热门市场技能，构建技能组合图，并搜索高风险链，其隐式诱饵不直接提及技能ID。基于该框架，作者构建了CompoSkill-Bench基准，包含来自OpenClaw和Nanobot平台上跨五个威胁类别、六个场景的长时程专业工作流共1140条记录。实验显示，CompoSkill在白盒设置下风险链形成率最高达83.3%，黑盒设置下达80.6%，而现有技能扫描器仅能拦截其中一小部分危险组合。此外，论文观察到“桥接技能-增益-随后跳数衰减”模式：桥接技能可提升攻击成功率，但当风险链长度超过三个技能时，进一步增加跳数反而降低攻击成功率。这些结果揭示了单一技能认证机制在自主AI智能体安全方面的系统性缺陷。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了当前AI智能体技能市场安全认证的根本性盲区——单技能扫描无法抵御组合式攻击，对依赖市场技能的自主智能体生态构成严重威胁，安全从业者需重新设计基于路径的审查机制。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响范围涵盖所有采用市场技能插件模式的自主AI智能体平台（如OpenClaw、Nanobot）及其用户；组合攻击模式可迁移到其他类似技能编排系统，威胁长时程任务中的敏感操作。
